# Isometric infographic recipe

Concept: a system diagram brought to life. An isometric diorama of flat three-tone blocks sits on a floating board, with thin ink pins, round insets, an extruded title plate, and numbers assembled from identical icons that pop in one at a time.

## Ground rules
- True isometric, flat. No perspective. No outlines on solids: tone is the only separator, three per block. The projection never rotates or tilts. Only the camera pans and zooms.
- Infographic furniture belongs to the picture: pins, leader lines, dashed routes, tracking rings, hatched section rims, a legend. Put it in the world or on a pale card. It is never ornament.
- Numbers are made of icons (Isotype): identical icons that sum to the figure.
- Diorama staging: the system rests on a floating board whose edges show a cross-section (soil, stone), over a pale ground with a faint isometric dot lattice.

Rule out:
- low-poly 3D (no lighting beyond the three face tones)
- a flat 2D explainer (everything needs isometric depth)
- a blueprint (use colour blocks, not line drawings)

## Geometry and surfaces
Projection: axes at 30 degrees.
- `sx = (x − y)·cos30°·k`
- `sy = ((x + y)/2 − z)·k`
- x runs down-right, y down-left, z up. Paint far to near, ordered by x + y.

Three tones from one base hue:
- top: base mixed about 22% toward warm white
- left (+y): the base itself
- right (+x): base mixed about 24% toward a cool dark, so shadows lean slightly blue
- In code, give each face a class (`t`, `l`, `r`) that reads a `--b` hue variable.

Ink lines: 2.4 px, round caps, used only for infographic parts (leaders, routes, rings, cut lines).

Board: a stack of slabs (grass-topped soil, stone, dark soil) with strata visible on the front faces, and a soft flat shadow underneath.

Terraces and plants: nested slabs plus small flat circles (base tone with a lighter offset circle), scattered from a seeded PRNG.

Title plate: a thin pale slab floating above the board. Letters are stacked six times in the dark tone, topped with one light copy. Place them on the ground plane with the matrix `(cos30·k, −½k, cos30·k, ½k)` so the text reads up and to the right.

People: billboards only. Tapered body, round head, a triangle straw hat, a tiny bob. No faces.

## Colour tokens
- `--latar`: pale ground. `--latar-2`: paper for plates, cards and panels.
- `--utama`: the one signal hue, on the subject (truck, awnings, title top via `--utama-di-latar`). `--aksen`: second flat hue (awning stripes, hats).
- Colour carries meaning as in a legend. Fixed hues: land leaf green, soil earth brown, stone road grey, walls cream, plus the dark chassis and windows. One hue never serves two meanings.
- Focus and context: lay a ground-coloured veil at about 60% over the board so only the subject keeps its colour.
- Text sits on its own surface: `--teks` on cards and halos, `--utama-di-latar` for the key word on paper.

## Type
`--font-judul` Poppins 800; `--font-isi` Poppins 500 (geometric sans).
- Title plate letters: 1.2 world units tall, tracking +0.05.
- Panel heads: caps, 0.1 em tracking, 26-54 px.
- Pin labels: 32 px, with an 8 px halo in the ground colour.
- Cards: 40 px.
- Icon-built figure: 96 px, tabular.

Pin anatomy: dot (ink ring, paper fill), then a vertical leader, a horizontal rule, the label. Pick the direction so the label never sits on the subject.

Subtitle as a map label: pale card, 12 px radius, 3 px ink border, a small iso cube chip, bottom-centre. Keep at least 170 px clear beneath the action.

## Timing
- A line goes first, always.
  - Route: draws over 1.5 s (`power1.inOut`) before the vehicle starts.
  - Leader: grows 0.4-0.5 s (`power2.out`) before an inset opens.
  - Cut line: draws in 0.3 s, then the skin slides off along its normal (about 70 px, 0.35 s, `power2.out`) and fades.
- Isotype fill: icons pop with `back.out(2.2)`, staggered about 0.055 s; the count-up spans the same time.
- Solids come in through movement, never alpha. Plates slide; vehicles run polylines with `power1.inOut`. The camera follows with the same ease and duration, so the subject stays locked.
- Camera moves take 1.1-1.6 s, `power2.inOut`. Hold at least 1.5 s while pins and labels appear. Show labels only while the camera is at rest.

## Camera
- Follow along a route: process, cause to effect. Delivery, journey, signal.
- Hold wide with a round inset: the system and one detail side by side. One worker in a workshop.
- Lock the frame while icons pile up: a total filling. A day's output, a queue.
- Pull out to the whole board: release, the big picture. Legend, finished map.
- Start tight on a detail: a question before the answer. One object on a plate.

Framing: the subject fills at least a third of frame height at key moments. Pins and cards never cover it.

## Signature moves
- Cutaway inset. Leader, round inset, cut line, near skin slides off, hatched rim remains. For: a repair shop opening a device, a farm slicing a fruit, a class opening up a model.
- Isotype number. Identical icons fill a grid as the figure counts up. For: kilos delivered, students enrolled, votes in a contest.
- Focus and context. Everything goes grey except one subject. For: one parcel in a courier chain, one dish in a canteen, one hero on a story map.
- Tracked subject with ring. A dashed ring travels under the moving object. For: a courier bike, a letter, a water drop.
- Scale reveal. Pull back until the final frame is a legend. For: a market day, a school timetable, a festival site.

## Pitfalls
- Semi-transparent moving solids look like ghosts. Slide them in; fade only what leaves.
- A vehicle touching the wrong surface looks like a crash. Leave clearance from stalls and trees.
- Painter order breaks on composite objects. Draw each composite as one ordered item.
- Never rotate or tilt the projection. Only the camera moves.
- Labels over the subject, or text without a halo over blocks.
- Keep the bottom ~170 px free for the card.

# Isometric infographic: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.2, long 4.6.

## hook

- en: an extruded isometric title plate lying over the diorama, one pin on it, a map-label card; the camera pulls back
- id: papan judul isometrik timbul di atas diorama, satu pin, kartu label peta; kamera menarik mundur

## problem

- en: everything desaturates except the subject; a dashed route line draws ahead of it, pins mark the stakes
- id: semua memudar kecuali subjek; garis rute putus-putus digambar mendahuluinya, pin menandai taruhannya

## fact

- en: a pin grows from the thing: dot, leader, rule, then the label wipes in; the rest of the board stays still
- id: pin tumbuh dari bendanya: titik, garis tegak, garis datar, lalu label menyapu masuk; papan lain diam

## step

- en: the camera follows the subject along its route; a leader grows into a round inset where a skin slides off to show the inside
- id: kamera mengikuti subjek di rutenya; garis penuntun tumbuh jadi inset bundar, kulitnya bergeser menampilkan isinya

## compare

- en: two boards or two zones side by side in the same three tones; only the winner keeps its colour, the other greys
- id: dua papan atau dua zona berdampingan dengan tiga nada sama; hanya pemenang yang berwarna, yang lain abu

## number

- en: identical icons pop in one by one with a back ease while the figure counts up over the same span
- id: ikon identik muncul satu per satu dengan back ease, angkanya menghitung naik selama rentang yang sama

## proof

- en: a round inset on a leader shows a close-up in the same flat tones, a short map-label card under it
- id: inset bundar di ujung garis penuntun menampilkan close-up bernada datar sama, kartu label pendek di bawahnya

## offer

- en: a legend panel slides in beside the board: the product as an icon row with its key, the price in the accent word
- id: panel legenda masuk di samping papan: produk sebagai baris ikon dengan kuncinya, harga di kata beraksen

## cta

- en: pull back to the whole board; the end frame is a legend with the contact, a 'not to scale' note; held 2 s
- id: tarik mundur ke seluruh papan; bingkai akhir berupa legenda dengan kontak dan catatan 'bukan skala'; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: fast pull-out until every label is on screen and the last frame is a finished infographic; held 2 s
- id: tarik mundur cepat sampai semua label terlihat dan bingkai akhir jadi infografis utuh; diam 2 detik

      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f2e6d0; --latar-2: #fbf4e6; --utama: #cf5140; --aksen: #e9be5c;

      .batu { --b: var(--batu); } .dinding { --b: var(--dinding); } .gelap { --b: var(--bayang); }
      .daun { --b: color-mix(in oklab, var(--hijau) 78%, var(--bayang)); } .kolp { --b: color-mix(in oklab, var(--hijau) 52%, var(--kertas)); }

      .pin text { font: 500 32px var(--font-isi); fill: var(--teks); paint-order: stroke; stroke: var(--latar); stroke-width: 8px; stroke-linejoin: round; }

      #p5 .tak { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: var(--teks-redup); margin-top: 14px; }
    </style>

    <script>
      (() => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
        const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
        const U = 26, C = Math.cos(Math.PI / 6);
        let seed = 11;
        const acak = () => {
          seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
          let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };

        // Proyeksi isometrik sejati: sumbu 30°, x ke kanan-bawah, y ke kiri-bawah, z ke atas.
        const P = (x, y, z = 0) => [(x - y) * C * U, ((x + y) / 2 - z) * U];
        const pts = (a) => a.map((p) => P(...p).map((v) => v.toFixed(1)).join(",")).join(" ");
        const poly = (a, c) => `<polygon class="${c}" points="${pts(a)}"/>`;
        // Balok: atas terang, kiri (+y) sedang, kanan (+x) gelap.
        const box = (x, y, z, w, d, h, hue, top = hue) => {
          const X = x + w, Y = y + d, Z = z + h;
          return poly([[x, y, Z], [X, y, Z], [X, Y, Z], [x, Y, Z]], `t ${top}`) + poly([[x, Y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, Y, Z], [x, Y, Z]], `l ${hue}`) + poly([[X, y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, Y, Z], [X, y, Z]], `r ${hue}`);
        };
        const atap = (x, y, z, w, d, h, hue) => {
          const X = x + w, Y = y + d, m = y + d / 2;
          return poly([[x, Y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, m, z + h], [x, m, z + h]], `l ${hue}`) + poly([[X, y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, m, z + h]], `r ${hue}`);
        };
        const kolBulat = (x, y, z, r) => { const [a, b] = P(x, y, z); return `<circle cx="${a.toFixed(1)}" cy="${(b - r * 0.6).toFixed(1)}" r="${r}" class="l hijau"/><circle cx="${(a - r * 0.28).toFixed(1)}" cy="${(b - r * 0.9).toFixed(1)}" r="${(r * 0.6).toFixed(1)}" class="t hijau"/>`; };

    <script>
      (() => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
        const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
        const U = 26, C = Math.cos(Math.PI / 6);
        let seed = 11;
        const acak = () => {
          seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
          let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };

        // Proyeksi isometrik sejati: sumbu 30°, x ke kanan-bawah, y ke kiri-bawah, z ke atas.
        const P = (x, y, z = 0) => [(x - y) * C * U, ((x + y) / 2 - z) * U];
        const pts = (a) => a.map((p) => P(...p).map((v) => v.toFixed(1)).join(",")).join(" ");
        const poly = (a, c) => `<polygon class="${c}" points="${pts(a)}"/>`;
        // Balok: atas terang, kiri (+y) sedang, kanan (+x) gelap.
        const box = (x, y, z, w, d, h, hue, top = hue) => {
          const X = x + w, Y = y + d, Z = z + h;
          return poly([[x, y, Z], [X, y, Z], [X, Y, Z], [x, Y, Z]], `t ${top}`) + poly([[x, Y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, Y, Z], [x, Y, Z]], `l ${hue}`) + poly([[X, y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, Y, Z], [X, y, Z]], `r ${hue}`);
        };
        const atap = (x, y, z, w, d, h, hue) => {
          const X = x + w, Y = y + d, m = y + d / 2;
          return poly([[x, Y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, m, z + h], [x, m, z + h]], `l ${hue}`) + poly([[X, y, z], [X, Y, z], [X, m, z + h]], `r ${hue}`);
        };
        const kolBulat = (x, y, z, r) => { const [a, b] = P(x, y, z); return `<circle cx="${a.toFixed(1)}" cy="${(b - r * 0.6).toFixed(1)}" r="${r}" class="l hijau"/><circle cx="${(a - r * 0.28).toFixed(1)}" cy="${(b - r * 0.9).toFixed(1)}" r="${(r * 0.6).toFixed(1)}" class="t hijau"/>`; };
        const pohon = (x, y) => {
          const [a, b] = P(x, y, 0), h = 30 + acak() * 14;
          return `<rect x="${a - 2}" y="${b - 12}" width="4" height="12" class="l tanah"/><polygon class="l daun" points="${a - 14},${b - 10} ${a},${b - 10} ${a},${b - h}"/><polygon class="r daun" points="${a},${b - 10} ${a + 14},${b - 10} ${a},${b - h}"/>`;
        };
        const orang = (id, x, y, z) => { const [a, b] = P(x, y, z); return `<g id="${id}"><polygon class="l utama" points="${a - 7},${b} ${a - 5},${b - 24} ${a + 5},${b - 24} ${a + 7},${b}"/><circle cx="${a}" cy="${b - 30}" r="6" class="l tanah"/><polygon class="t aksen" points="${a - 11},${b - 33} ${a + 11},${b - 33} ${a},${b - 44}"/></g>`; };
        const warung = () => box(12.5, 8, 0, 1.5, 1.5, 1.2, "dinding") + atap(12.35, 7.9, 1.2, 1.8, 1.7, 0.8, "utama") + box(12.9, 9.5, 0.1, 0.5, 0.05, 0.6, "gelap");
        const lapak = (x) => { let s = box(x, 0.7, 0, 1.5, 1.2, 0.8, "dinding"); for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) s += box(x - 0.1 + i * 0.45, 0.6, 0.85, 0.45, 1.4, 0.12, i % 2 ? "aksen" : "utama"); return s + kolBulat(x + 0.4, 1.2, 0.8, 7) + kolBulat(x + 1.0, 1.3, 0.8, 7); };

        function bangunDunia() {
          // Papan melayang dengan lapisan tanah di tepinya.
          let s = box(0, 0, -1.6, 14, 12, 0.5, "tanah2") + box(0, 0, -1.1, 14, 12, 0.5, "batu") + box(0, 0, -0.6, 14, 12, 0.6, "tanah", "hijau");
          s += poly([[6.4, 2.4, 0.02], [12.1, 2.4, 0.02], [12.1, 10, 0.02], [10.9, 10, 0.02], [10.9, 3.6, 0.02], [6.4, 3.6, 0.02]], "t batu");
          // Lereng terasering: empat undak, tanaman kol disebar dari PRNG berbiji.
          for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const o = 1 + i * 0.65, w = 5.6 - i * 1.3, z = 0.55 * i;
            s += box(o, o, z, w, w, 0.55, "tanah", "hijau");
            const zt = z + 0.55, tanam = [];
            for (let gx = o + 0.5; gx < o + w - 0.3; gx += 0.78) for (let gy = o + 0.5; gy < o + w - 0.3; gy += 0.78) {
              if (gx > o + 1.3 && gy > o + 1.3) continue;
              tanam.push([gx + (acak() - 0.5) * 0.2, gy + (acak() - 0.5) * 0.2]);
            }
            tanam.sort((p, q) => p[0] + p[1] - q[0] - q[1]);
            s += tanam.map((p) => kolBulat(p[0], p[1], zt, 6.5)).join("");
          }
          // Benda lain diurutkan dari belakang ke depan (x + y) agar tumpang-tindihnya benar.
          const benda = [[7.8, `${box(7.4, 4.6, 0, 1.4, 1.4, 1.1, "dinding")}${atap(7.3, 4.5, 1.1, 1.6, 1.6, 0.8, "tanah2")}`], [8, lapak(8)], [9.8, lapak(9.8)], [11.6, lapak(11.6)], [22, warung()]];
          benda[0][0] = 12.2; benda[1][0] = 8.7; benda[2][0] = 10.5; benda[3][0] = 12.3;
          for (let n = 0; n < 30; n++) {
            const x = 0.5 + acak() * 13, y = 0.5 + acak() * 11;
            if ((x < 7.4 && y < 7.4) || (x > 6 && y > 1.8 && y < 4.2) || (x > 10.2 && x < 12.6 && y > 2) || (x > 7 && y < 2.6) || (x > 11.8 && y > 7.4 && y < 10) || (x > 7 && x < 9.4 && y > 4 && y < 6.4)) continue;
            benda.push([x + y, pohon(x, y)]);
          }
          benda.push([6.2, orang("o1", 3.2, 2.6, 1.1)], [8.6, orang("o2", 4.8, 3.9, 0.55)]);
          benda.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]);
          $("#statis").innerHTML = s + benda.map((b) => b[1]).join("");
          const ruteD = `M${P(7, 3, 0.05)} L${P(11.5, 3, 0.05)} L${P(11.5, 9.5, 0.05)}`;
          $("#rute").setAttribute("d", ruteD); $("#mpath").setAttribute("d", ruteD);
        }
        // Truk pick-up dua arah: ke +x di jalan pertama, ke +y di jalan kedua; satu per sumbu.
        function truk(sumbu) {
          const T = (a, b, z, w, d, h, hue) => (sumbu === "x" ? box(a, b, z, w, d, h, hue) : box(b, a, z, d, w, h, hue));
          let s = T(-1, -0.7, 0, 0.5, 1.4, 0.35, "gelap") + T(0.5, -0.7, 0, 0.5, 1.4, 0.35, "gelap") + T(-1.4, -0.6, 0.35, 1.9, 1.2, 0.45, "utama") + T(0.5, -0.6, 0.35, 0.9, 1.2, 1, "dinding") + T(1.38, -0.45, 0.85, 0.06, 0.9, 0.35, "gelap");
          for (const [a, b] of [[-1.1, -0.2], [-0.6, 0.25], [-0.5, -0.3], [-0.1, 0.1], [-0.05, -0.35]]) s += sumbu === "x" ? kolBulat(a, b, 0.8, 8) : kolBulat(b, a, 0.8, 8);
          return s;
        }
        bangunDunia();
        $("#tx").innerHTML = truk("x");
        $("#ty").innerHTML = truk("y");

        // Papan judul timbul di bidang tanah: huruf bertumpuk (ekstrusi), terbaca naik ke kanan.
        function bangunPapan() {
          const o = P(6.3, 10.5, 3.25), ma = `matrix(${C * U} ${-0.5 * U} ${C * U} ${0.5 * U}`;
          let s = box(4.3, 1.1, 3, 2.9, 9.7, 0.25, "plat");
          for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) s += `<text class="huruf-sisi" transform="${ma} ${o[0]} ${(o[1] - k * 0.1 * U).toFixed(1)})">KOL SUBUH</text>`;
          s += `<text class="huruf-atas" transform="${ma} ${o[0]} ${(o[1] - 0.6 * U).toFixed(1)})">KOL SUBUH</text>`;
          s += `<text class="sub-plat" transform="${ma} ${o[0]} ${(o[1] - 0.25 * U + 0.7 * 0.5 * U).toFixed(1)})" x="0.3" y="0.78">dari lereng ke warung</text>`;
          $("#banner").innerHTML = s;
        }
        bangunPapan();
        // Inset: irisan kol berlingkar-lingkar di bawah, kulit utuh di atasnya (dua belahan).
        const kulit = `<circle r="130" class="l hijau"/><circle cx="-34" cy="-40" r="84" class="t hijau"/><path d="M0 -126 Q40 0 0 126 M-110 -40 Q0 -70 110 -30 M-100 50 Q0 20 100 56" class="ink" style="stroke-width:3;opacity:.55"/>`;
        $("#kulit-a").innerHTML = kulit; $("#kulit-b").innerHTML = kulit;
        $("#irisan").innerHTML = [130, 104, 78, 52, 26].map((r, i) => `<circle r="${r}" class="${i % 2 ? "l" : "t"} hijau"/>`).join("") + `<circle r="122" style="fill:none;stroke:url(#arsir);stroke-width:14"/><circle r="130" class="ink" style="stroke-width:3"/>`;

        // Close-up datar (dua nada tiap bentuk): tanaman kol, satu kol jatuh ke telapak tangan; lengan berlengan merah dengan strip manset.
        function bangunDekat() {
          const ov = (cx, cy, rx, ry, rot, c) => `<ellipse cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" rx="${rx}" ry="${ry}" transform="rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})" class="${c}"/>`;
          let d = "";
          for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const a = i * 0.9 + 0.3, x = 540 + Math.cos(a) * 190, y = 590 + Math.sin(a) * 120; d += ov(x, y, 190, 80, a * 57.3, i % 2 ? "l daun" : "l hijau") + ov(x, y, 150, 5, a * 57.3, "t hijau"); }
          d += `<circle cx="540" cy="600" r="34" class="l tanah"/>`;
          d += `<g id="kolj"><circle r="112" class="l kolp"/><circle cx="-30" cy="-34" r="74" class="t kolp"/><path d="M0 -108 Q34 0 0 108 M-98 -34 Q0 -60 98 -26 M-88 44 Q0 20 88 50" class="ink" style="stroke-width:3;opacity:.5"/></g>`;
          // Tangan telapak naik: lengan dari kiri-bawah; sudut lengan (-0,62; 0,78).
          const ar = [-0.62, 0.78], nr = [0.78, 0.62], pt = (t, w) => `${(ar[0] * t + nr[0] * w).toFixed(0)},${(ar[1] * t + nr[1] * w).toFixed(0)}`;
          d += `<g id="tangan"><polygon class="l tanah" points="${pt(60, -75)} ${pt(700, -120)} ${pt(700, 120)} ${pt(60, 75)}"/><polygon class="l utama" points="${pt(260, -105)} ${pt(900, -170)} ${pt(900, 170)} ${pt(260, 105)}"/><polygon class="l aksen" points="${pt(215, -100)} ${pt(255, -104)} ${pt(255, 104)} ${pt(215, 100)}"/><polygon class="r utama" points="${pt(260, 10)} ${pt(900, 20)} ${pt(900, 170)} ${pt(260, 105)}"/>`
            + `<polygon class="l tanah" points="-95,-50 5,-85 100,-40 105,45 40,95 -55,75 -100,10"/><polygon class="r tanah" points="-20,60 40,95 105,45 100,-10"/>`
            + [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => `<path d="M${-60 + i * 38},${-70 + i * 6} Q${-10 + i * 48},${-190 + i * 14} ${60 + i * 52},${-170 + i * 30}" class="jari tanah" style="stroke-width:34"/>`).join("")
            + `<path d="M-80,30 Q-170,10 -150,-70" class="jari tanah" style="stroke-width:38"/></g>`;
          $("#adegan0").innerHTML = d;
          gsap.set("#tangan", { x: 540, y: 1020 });
          gsap.set("#kolj", { x: 540, y: 600 });
        }
        bangunDekat();

        // Kamera = titik dasar (px) di tengah layar + zoom; hanya grup #cam yang bergerak.
